dedupe_keys.name: vitoria gasteiz heritage dwelling envelope thermal tests

description: This Mendeley Data deposit publishes monitoring and test files for two unoccupied dwellings in a retrofitted heritage building in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain. Researchers used fixed and mobile monitoring systems for co-heating, QUB and ISO 9869 thermal-transmittance tests to estimate heat-transfer and envelope properties. The current version 2 inventory lists thirty-four CSV files, including monitoring periods with 2019–2021 filenames. Tests used electric heaters and the installed aerothermal heat-pump system. The public repository states CC BY 4.0. Coverage is two living-lab dwellings within one building, not the city’s housing stock or normal occupied energy use. Test boundary conditions, retrofit history and heating method limit comparisons with occupied houses. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating envelope heat-loss parameters in building simulations. model-energyplus is a related simulation tool, but no direct importer or fitted model was verified. The article names a separate in-use companion dataset; this record covers only the envelope-test DOI. No CSV data were downloaded.
